CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.

2. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

5. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

6. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

8. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

10. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
